Account.MoneyLeavesOnlyByWithdrawalOrTra.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
      before._tag !== "Open" ||
      after._tag !== "Open" ||
      after.balance >= before.balance ||
      command._tag === "WithdrawMoney" ||
      command._tag === "DebitTransfer"

RegisterCustomer.TheNameGoesToWhoRegiste.source:
({ after, command }) =>
      after.customer._tag === "Registered" &&
      after.customer.username === command.username &&
      after.claim._tag === "Claimed" &&
      after.claim.customerId === command.customerId

Bank.AClaimedNameBelongsToItsCustomer.source:
({ customer, claim }) =>
        claim.state._tag !== "Claimed" ||
        claim.state.customerId !== customer.id ||
        (customer.state._tag === "Registered" && customer.state.username === claim.id)

Bank.ARegisteredCustomerHoldsTheirName.source:
({ customer, claim }) =>
        customer.state._tag !== "Registered" ||
        customer.state.username !== claim.id ||
        (claim.state._tag === "Claimed" && claim.state.customerId === customer.id)
